spans.s:
इली [इल्-क ङीष्] A cudgel,
a stick shaped like a sword, a short
sword (करवाल).

इलीबिशः^1 N. of a demon
conquered by Indra.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: Wrong spelling of a name of a demon from RV..

इलीशः^1, इल्लिशः A sort of fish,
commonly hilsa or sable.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: sergeA thought it should be left unchanged.

इलीशः^1, इल्लिशः A sort of fish,
commonly hilsa or sable.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: sergeA thought it should be left unchanged.

ईलिः^1 (ली f.)
1 A weapon, a
cudgel or a short sword.
--2 A
stick shaped like a sword (
करवालिका).
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: By alph. order..
